concerns.text: FR-001 specifies amorphous filtering 'via the `material_type` metadata field or by presence of the keyword "glass" in the entry description', but T002 implements a different mechanism (MP `entry.data['tags']`, `structure_type` substring, missing space-group info). No task covers or even probes the FR-specified `material_type`/description-keyword filter, so an implementer cannot satisfy FR-001 as written. Add a task (or extend T002) to check `material_type`/description keyword first, with the current heuristics as documented fallback.

T002 mandates a hard pipeline stop when the metallic-glass subset is < 50 entries, but US-1 scenario 1 explicitly requires the system to proceed and log a warning when < 500 entries are available, 'treating this as a valid pass condition'. The task converts a spec-sanctioned pass path into a failure, so the spec's graceful-degradation behavior has no covering task. Align T002's stop threshold with the spec (warn-and-continue below 500; stop only on empty/unusable data per the spec's own terms).
